annotateTitle: Add a comment to the selected text
newSubtitle: The draft keeps a compact reference. Its quote and comment expand when you submit.
placeholderCreate: Explain the issue, add context, or say what you would like changed…
createHint: Ctrl/⌘+Enter to add · Esc to cancel
editHint: Ctrl/⌘+Enter to save · Esc to cancel
listHint: Esc to close · Stored in this browser tab until it closes
listSummary: {total} comments · {queued} included in the next message · Select to edit
submittedDescription: Submitted from this draft; delivery is not confirmed here. You can add it again.
detachedDescription: Not in the draft. You can add it again.
statusQueuedTitle: {count} comments are included in the next message. Open to review, edit, or delete.
statusSubmittedTitle: {count} comments left the draft during submission. Delivery is not confirmed here.
statusDetachedTitle: {count} comments are not in the draft. Open to review or add them again.
label: Comment {number}
noteRequired: Please write a comment, or choose Cancel.
selectionExpired: The selected text is no longer available. Select it again.
addedToast: Comment {number} added as a compact reference
deleteFailed: Could not remove {token}. Remove its reference from the draft and try again.
busy: Wait for the current submission to finish before changing comments.
missing: This comment is unavailable in this browser tab. Remove the reference and add the quote again; it will not be sent as a bare token.
invalidReference: A reference has invalid or overlapping text offsets. The draft was not changed.
storageUnavailable: Tab storage is unavailable. Comments work in memory, but will not survive a page refresh.
clearedToast: All comments and their draft references were deleted
tooLong: The quote and comment must each be at most 20,000 characters.
